item.title: Bill Belichick snubbed by Pro Football Hall of Fame in first year of eligibility, report says
item.description: Six-time Super Bowl champion head coach Bill Belichick didn't get voted into the Pro Football Hall of Fame in his first year of eligibility, according to a report from ESPN.

item.title: UPS retires fleet of MD-11 aircraft involved in deadly Kentucky crash
item.description: UPS announced Tuesday that it has retired its fleet of McDonnell Douglas MD-11 cargo planes just months after one crashed during takeoff, causing 15 deaths in Louisville.

item.title: Krypto-Knight: West Bladen stays perfect in SEC with 73-59 win at South Brunswick
item.description: The battle of the top two teams in the Southeastern Conference went the way of unbeaten West Bladen with a 73-59 road win over South Brunswick on Tuesday.

item.title: Town of Leland looking at possible changes to its zoning and subdivision ordinances
